# VENIZOR

> Independent technology studio based in India. Websites, web applications, mobile apps, SaaS products and practical AI workflows.

## Services
- [Website development](https://venizor.com/services/web-development): for businesses with something to say
- [Web application development](https://venizor.com/services/web-applications): for startups and growing teams
- [Mobile app development](https://venizor.com/services/mobile-app-development): for useful everyday experiences
- [AI & workflow automation](https://venizor.com/services/ai-automation): for teams with work to simplify
- [SaaS product development](https://venizor.com/services/saas-product-development): for founders building the next useful product
- [Digital marketing](https://venizor.com/services/digital-marketing): for businesses ready to learn what works
- [Technical SEO](https://venizor.com/services/seo): for sites that deserve to be found
- [Answer engine optimization](https://venizor.com/services/answer-engine-optimization): for clear, credible business information

Architecture scenarios, product concepts and simulator outputs are illustrative. They are not verified client engagements or production performance benchmarks. Timelines, costs and service commitments are agreed per project.
